panes.title: BOTH SET TO 100 AT THE ANCHOR
panes.sub: hashrate against what a block pays

post.x: kaspa's hashrate is up 3 percent against 4 weeks ago. over the same days the block reward fell 5.61 percent, as it does every month by design. more machines securing the chain, less new supply paying for them. that gap is the whole security question.
post.reply: the schedule behind the reward is on kaspapulse.com/kaspa-halving.html. we report the movement, never the motive.
